answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a bonded stake whose reputation erodes along a spiral of verified ablation, much like the karst-like pitting of a carbon-silicon carbide shield tracked by thermocouples. Each new agent must post an ivory-clean deposit that decays with every unverified claim, forcing attackers to accumulate costly collateral across. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
